entities.name: Burning Isles
entities.description: Highly volcanic archipelago in the easternmost Domains of Dominaria, claimed by a dozen lords.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: Continent south of the Burning Isles.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: Land east of the Burning Isles.

entities.name: Shipbuilders' Guild
entities.description: Guild that began logging the Burning Isles' woods.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: Sent as an envoy to stop the Shipbuilders' Guild.

events.summary: The Shipbuilders' Guild began systematically logging the woods of the Burning Isles, and Multani was sent as an envoy to stop them.
events.quote: Multani was sent as an envoy to stop them.
